name: ChordRes from rest with saved forces
tagline: A spherical residual stream with depth-wise tangent velocity.
description: Each sublayer reads a scalar lookahead and writes a normalized update with parallel and perpendicular step sizes. The initial velocity is zero; later velocities are generated by the actual hidden displacements.
mechanism: Unit-RMS hidden state and a per-token tangent velocity
Independent scalar controls for each attention and FFN site
BF16 force tensors retained on the GPU for the fused Chord backward
limitations: Uses the shared zero-initialized output projections and reference optimizer. The full leaderboard result requires the 46,875-update endpoint.
